caption:
Good deeds and a good life: a promise for this Saturday morning.

Allah says that whoever does righteous deeds, male or female, while being a believer, will be granted a good life. And they will be rewarded according to the best of their deeds.

Surah An-Nahl 16:97

Pick one good deed and get it done before noon.

#quran #gooddeeds #goodlife #muslimhabits
alt_text: Whoever does righteous deeds, male or female, while being a believer, We will surely grant him a good life, and We will surely reward them according to the best of their deeds (Surah An-Nahl 16:97)
